## Design requirements

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The component follows the Tilecast design system.
- [ ] The layout works at supported desktop and narrow-screen widths.
- [ ] Light and dark modes remain consistent.
- [ ] Keyboard and focus behavior remain usable.
- [ ] Text and controls do not overflow or become clipped.
- [ ] Relevant visual or component tests are updated.
